# Not generated by bazel_to_cmake: the dynamic half has no Bazel counterpart,
# since iree_compiler_register_dynamic_plugin is CMake-only.

iree_lit_test_suite(
  NAME
    lit
  SRCS
    "static_link.mlir"
  TOOLS
    FileCheck
    iree-compile
)

if(IREE_COMPILER_DYNAMIC_PLUGINS)
  iree_lit_test_suite(
    NAME
      lit_dynamic
    SRCS
      "dynamic_link.mlir"
    TOOLS
      FileCheck
      iree-compile
  )

  # The module path reaches the RUN lines through the environment, which
  # samples/lit.cfg.py forwards for every IREE_* variable and uses to decide
  # whether the iree_dynamic_plugins feature is available. Recompute the test
  # name the way iree_lit_test does so the two cannot drift apart.
  iree_package_ns(_PACKAGE_NS)
  string(REPLACE "::" "/" _PACKAGE_PATH ${_PACKAGE_NS})
  set_property(TEST "${_PACKAGE_PATH}/dynamic_link.mlir.test"
    APPEND PROPERTY ENVIRONMENT
    "IREE_EXAMPLE_DYN_PLUGIN=$<TARGET_FILE:iree_compiler_plugin_example_dyn>"
  )
endif()
